theme: An open Saturday in St. Pete, with a lighter Sunday on deck.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — no meetings on the books and the girls around at the Coffee Pot cottage. Today asks little of you; tomorrow asks a bit more.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority board task, overdue since Sep 14: reserve a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week before holiday inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: December break not yet decided
needsAttention.detail: The shortlist was due Sep 30 and the Oct 15 booking date has passed; six people over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year, so pick domestic vs. international and lock it.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute board review is at 9 AM — arrive ready to clear the inbox, put an owner and a date on everything, and chase what you're waiting on.

needsAttention.title: Island associations' annual meeting
needsAttention.detail: The DIRA & DIBA annual meeting is tomorrow at 5 PM on Zoom; the materials were emailed separately, so skim them before you join.

flagged.title: Venmo request from the lawn service
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for mowing on Oct 14 — a quick pay whenever you're ready.

flagged.title: LinkedIn connect from IFAC's education director
flagged.detail: Bruce at the International Federation of Accountants is waiting on a response — worth a look given your governance network.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Monocle, Trip.com, the Midcoast Villager, Puzzmo and the like.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn's winter squash and pumpkins are at their peak now, ideal for something slow-roasted and warming.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar before noon — the morning is entirely yours.
The afternoon holds no meetings either; a rare fully open stretch.
A calm night at the bayou with the girls around.
